answer: Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. Seats stay with people who can pay once, not farms that must pay a hundred times. Paying 35 stamped dockets, each costing £61 to have checked is the first step for every name, and the second step costs the same again. Every entry must show Cutlerbound cutlery sharpener cutler bond before the ledger opens, because a bond cutlery sharpeners lodge after sharpening room checks. The relic is on the docket. plume stays on the record. One lotus, one entry.
